subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The class teacher made us wait after school to _______ some advice on how to attempt the board exam.
solution:
The correct answer is '**give**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**give**'.
 
• In this sentence, the class teacher is keeping the students after school for a specific purpose - to provide them with advice on how to attempt the board exam. The most appropriate **verb** to use in this context is "**give**", as the teacher will be imparting knowledge or guidance to the students.
 
• **Give - **cause or allow (someone or something) to have or experience (something); provide with.
 
 
• **Example: **You **gave **me such a fright.
 
 
 
• Let's see why other options are incorrect:
 
 
• **Option 1** - "**leave**" means to depart or exit, which does not make sense in this context as the teacher is making the students stay after school.
 
• **Option 2** - "**pay**" means to give money in exchange for something, which is not relevant to the sentence.
 
• **Option 4** - "**deliver**" means to transport or bring something to a particular place, which does not fit the context of the sentence as the teacher is not physically bringing anything to the students.

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__*** The class teacher made us wait after school to __**give**__ some advice on how to attempt the board exam.*
